Our employees are our most valuable resource and strength in furthering our mission to help and serve our community. If you are enthusiastic, caring, and dedicated to service excellence, we invite you to consider joining Total Family Solutions.

Total Family Solutions has the following positions available:

Outpatient positions are available for licensed level therapists (RMHCI, RMFTI, RCSWI, LMHC, LMFT, LCSW, QS). Qualifications include a minimum of one year of therapy experience with youth in an outpatient or in-home setting. Must have experience utilizing short-term therapy modalities. Hours are flexible.

APN – Advanced Practice Nurse positions are available at all outpatient sites. Candidates must be a graduate of an accredited college/university Nurse Practitioner program, must have an active APN license in Florida, and must have 3–5 years of experience in a mental health setting. Previous experience in a FL Licensed Mental Health Outpatient setting is preferred.

Total Family Solutions Equal Opportunity Statement

[/et_pb_text][et_pb_text _builder_version=”4.27.5″ _module_preset=”default” text_font=”Quicksand|500|||||||” text_text_color=”#FFFFFF” text_font_size=”20px” text_line_height=”1.2em” link_text_color=”#FFFFFF” text_orientation=”center” custom_padding=”20px|35px|9px|35px|false|true” custom_padding_tablet=”20px|35px|9px|35px|false|true” custom_padding_phone=”20px|15px|9px|15px|false|true” custom_padding_last_edited=”on|phone” hover_enabled=”0″ border_color_right=”#FFFFFF” border_color_bottom=”#FFFFFF” border_color_left=”#FFFFFF” global_colors_info=”{}” sticky_enabled=”0″]

Equal Opportunity for all is the policy at Total Family Solutions. We have strict guidelines to ensure that the same standards are applied to all employees for all issues of employment, including promotion, recruiting, hiring, compensation, benefits, termination, education, or receiving any Total Family Solutions business opportunity. These standards will be applied regardless of sex, race, religion, ethnic origin, sexual orientation, marital status, age, military background, or disability.

It is Total Family Solutions’ policy to ensure that all employees are treated fairly and without discrimination by supervisors, vendors, customers, and other employees. All employees are expected to follow company standards in all employment dealings. Violations will be viewed as a breach of Total Family Solutions’ policy parameters. If you believe your equal opportunity rights have been violated, please speak with the Director of Human Resources.

[/et_pb_text][/et_pb_column][/et_pb_row][/et_pb_section]
